brief: Ukraine's banking/payments trade-press layer is dense and unusually explicit about dates: FinClub, Дебет-Кредит (news.dtkt.ua), PaySpace Magazine and Banker.ua routinely name NBU consultation cut-offs, transition periods ('90 days') and effective dates, often while a measure is still a draft (проєкт Положення) under громадське обговорення. A second tier — Mind.ua, Ekonomichna Pravda, NV Business, RBC-Ukraine, sud.ua — supplies banker reaction and lay-language 'what changes from <date>' explainers useful for detecting lobbying pressure and slippage, while FINBALANCE uniquely covers NBU's own supervisory reorganisation. English coverage is thinner and concentrated in Interfax-Ukraine (partly paid), Kyiv Post syndication, The Paypers and Ukrainian law-firm legal alerts, which are the most precise English source for resolution numbers and in-force dates. The main structural weaknesses are distribution (much of this ecosystem's fastest signal moves through Telegram channels, only one of which was captured) and the absence of association media (EMA, NABU) whose consultation submissions are the earliest indicator that a deadline is contested.
